# togetherai_shared_volume (Resource)

A shared volume (high-bandwidth shared filesystem) for GPU clusters. A volume created on its own outlives any cluster it is attached to, and keeps billing until it is deleted. It cannot be deleted while a cluster uses it.

The size can only grow: Terraform rejects a smaller `size_tib` at plan time, because shrinking a volume needs Together AI's account team.

A volume created on its own goes to the region's datacenter with the most free GPUs, so attaching it to a cluster can fail. Set `instance_cluster_id`, or create the volume with the cluster (`shared_volume` on `togetherai_gpu_cluster`).

**Cost:** $0.16 per GiB per month on the public price list, so a 1 TiB volume is about $164 per month (about $0.22 per hour).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "togetherai_shared_volume" "datasets" {
  name     = "datasets"
  size_tib = 2
  region   = "us-central-8"
}

# Attach it to a cluster in the same region.
resource "togetherai_gpu_cluster" "batch" {
  name                  = "batch"
  region                = togetherai_shared_volume.datasets.region
  gpu_type              = "H100_SXM"
  billing_type          = "ON_DEMAND"
  num_gpus              = 8
  cuda_version          = "12.8"
  nvidia_driver_version = "570"
  volume_id             = togetherai_shared_volume.datasets.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Volume name: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and dots, up to 44 characters. Changing it replaces the volume (and its data).
- `region` (String) Region, such as `us-central-8`. Create-only. The API does not return it, so after an import set it to the volume's real region.
- `size_tib` (Number) Size in whole TiB. Can be increased in place.

### Optional

- `instance_cluster_id` (String) Place the volume on the same infrastructure as this GPU cluster. Create-only.
- `is_lifecycle_independent` (Boolean) Keep the volume when a cluster it is attached to is decommissioned. The docs say a volume created on its own is always independent. Create-only.
- `project_id` (String) Project that owns the volume. Defaults to the API key's project. Create-only.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Volume ID (`volume_id`).
- `status` (String) Volume status, such as `available` or `bound`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a shared volume by its volume ID. Set region in the configuration to
# the volume's real region: the API does not return it.
terraform import togetherai_shared_volume.datasets <volume_id>
```
